Do give it a try for chronic health issues, you may come out pleasantly surprised.

I went to Brain & Co in May 2024 for a persistent balance issue that started in Dec 2022. While it started as a severe case of vertigo, it eventually settled into a permanent state of imbalance if I tilted my head forward, backward or sideways. Having tried all that I could, including conventional Allopathy, Homeopathy,
Acupuncture & Ayurveda without much success, I was always researching on what was the one thing could help me.

I came across Neurofeedback/Biofeedback as a treatment option for dizziness/imbalance on the Internet and looked up the clinics offering it in Mumbai. Luckily, I zeroed down on Brain&Co and visited their Parel clinic for the first consultation. That first visit gave me some confidence though I remained skeptical, as I thought how could brain training help if the dizziness had a physical component to it. Also while looking up Neurofeedback over the Internet, I came across reviews stating it hampered the functioning of the brain in negative ways, people started hallucinating, hearing voices etc which did make me nervous.

But 6+ months down the line, I can say I am glad I gave it a try without giving into my skepticism & fears.

My dizziness/imbalance has come down from a 10 to a 5 which is a very big deal for me. Not only that, I had had severe migraines right from my college days for over two decades that I mistook for sinus headaches & something that I considered as part and parcel of life. Anything would trigger a migraine like sunlight, exhaustion, exposure to cold etc. But somewhere during the Neurofeedback sessions these headaches kind of disappeared altogether from my life. I am happy to say I have not had a single bout of severe migraine since May even if I roam in the hot sun !  I would call it an added bonus as that was something I was not looking to get resolved in the first place. I am quite happy to experience a headache free life, headaches are so common that no one ever imagines one can and should be headache free forever.  I also see a noticeable improvement in my general mood, where I am able to face the issues in life with a more relaxed state of mind. Things that used to make me sad or anxious in the past don't seem insurmountable now.

Here I would really like to thank Rohit from the bottom of my heart for his utmost patience, positive words and the confidence he showed that my condition can be cured.Since the changes were slow to show up, I was losing faith that it would work but diligently kept up with my weekly sessions and finally I have started seeing some results. This has been possible only because of Rohit and his constant encouragement. The staff (Nikita & Deepak) are courteous and polite and seem to know each patient's movie preference which feels like personalized attention :)

Again I am extremely happy that I came to know about Brain & Co's existence and would sincerely recommend everyone suffering from chronic health conditions to give it a try. Rohit and his team of experts can guide on what conditions can be helped with, so it is worth to atleast go with the first consultation. The clinic has a soothing ambience with a wonderful staff. Each Saturday I am happy to go there as I get to watch a good movie with full concentration and without any worries or cares floating into my mind. I would not mind going there for the rest of my life :) it is that enjoyable.

Wishing Rohit, his team & staff many more glorious years of helping others. Sometimes charity is done as a business & at other times business is done as a charity - Brain&Co is the latter !
